body.name: current-task selector-correction transition
body.construction: For the current least task, write \(\zeta\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}}\zeta'\) when the compiler's scan finds a least selector-gate occurrence \(\sigma=(s,X,r,x_s)\) actually present in its labelled context kernel. Necessarily \(s\in H\), and the stored zero--one multiplexer has intervention status one and value \(x_s\) at that occurrence. Replace only that occurrence by \(\mathbf 1\{X=x_s\}\), substitute \(x_s\) in its children, append the resulting coordinate-copy equalities to \(\mathcal J\), and rescan the successor kernel. Initialization uses the displayed context normalizer \(p_H(S=s)=\sum_v p_H(v,s)\); the gate rewrite introduces no division. The transition is eligible precisely when its finite syntax check and its cross-multiplied polynomial identity modulo \(\mathcal J\) hold.
